If Telos Network stops or fails, your internet goes back to normal. It never starts by itself unless you turn on start on boot.
Telos Network is new and has not been tested on many devices yet. You can turn it off at any time.

Open the Android VPN settings to make Telos Network always on. Telos never does this by itself. Leave lockdown off if you want the internet to keep working when Telos Network stops.
If Android stops Telos Network in the background, exempt it from battery optimisation.
What Telos Network does not do
No subscription and no RPN: there is no paid proxy service, no account and no server of ours.
No experimental features: only the stable parts of the Rethink engine are used.
It cannot look inside encrypted connections. It filters by app, address and domain.
It does not make you anonymous. Websites still see your IP address unless you use a WireGuard tunnel you trust.
Android allows one VPN at a time. Telos Network replaces another VPN while it runs; use WireGuard inside Telos Network instead.
It is new and has not been tested on many devices yet.
